description:
Code accompanying Classical simulability and hardware diagnostics for QAOA on geographic coverage benchmarks.

This code-only deposit excludes the article, supplemental manuscript, figures, raw data, result archives and calibration responses. The article will be deposited separately on arXiv. Archived-input workflows require external inputs not included in this release.
